exposure: Hematocrit levels in the first 3 days of life
cohort: 216 premature infants with IVH (n=108) and gestational age- and birth weight-matched control group infants (n=108) admitted to a neonatal intensive care unit in Saudi Arabia.
finding: Lack of antenatal dexamethasone, patent ductus arteriosus (PDA), neonatal hydrocortisone administration, and low hematocrit in the first 3 days of life were significantly associated with severe intraventricular hemorrhage (IVH) in very-low-birth-weight (VLBW) neonates.
